General SNAP Benefits Calculation Rules

Federal Framework (Non-State-Specific)

────────────────────────────────────────

Core Calculation Formula

SNAP Benefit Amount = Maximum Benefit for Household Size - (Net Income * 0.15)

If the result is less than $0, the household receives $0 in benefits

────────────────────────────────────────

Step-by-Step Calculation Process

Step 1: Determine Gross Income

Calculate total monthly gross income from all sources for all household members.

Step 2: Apply Income Deductions (Gross to Net)

Subtract the following deductions from gross income to determine net income:

A. Standard Deduction (2025)

•     1-3 people: $198

•     4 people: $199

•     5 people: $234

•     6+ people: $268

Step 4: Apply Benefit Formula

•     Use the core formula: Maximum Benefit - (Net Income * 0.15)
